# Capture checklist: Towns and cities

<!-- Generated by `node core/bin/capture.ts build` from data/vocab/types.json and core/src/schema/capture/properties.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

R is required for Usable, R? is required when its condition holds, A is applicable (counts for Complete). Properties not listed are never asked. Suitability paths are listed under their profile; the full list for a type is `node core/bin/capture.ts fields --type <id>`.

## Towns and cities (`settlement`)

Records: place. Suitability profile `town` (never). Effort: none, time is shown. Sources, in order: F T D X.

**place**: R name, type, point, area_id, wikidata, geonames_id, summary, access_cost, class_key, draw, standing, distinction, easy_payoff, weather, why, signals, links; R? near_town (derived); A names, osm_ref, best_window, best_time, transit, pairs_with, photos, part_of.

Suitability: R stroller, wheelchair; R when operated none; A kid_note, stroller_extent, access_detail, accessible_toilet, accessible_parking, limited_capacity_note, on_site_min, toilets, baby_change.

Links: official; R? none; A tourism_board, timetable, wikidata, wikipedia, wikivoyage.

### Cluster (`settlement.cluster`)

Records: place. Suitability profile `area` (never, extension area). Effort: none, time is shown. Sources, in order: F T D X.

**place**: R name, type, point, area_id, wikidata, geonames_id, summary, access_cost, class_key, draw, standing, distinction, easy_payoff, weather, why, signals, links; R? near_town (derived); A names, osm_ref, best_window, best_time, transit, pairs_with, photos, part_of.

Suitability: R kid_note, on_site_min, hazards, access_season; R when operated none; A group_min, stroller, stroller_extent, wheelchair, accessible_toilet, limited_capacity_note, toilets, water, food, signal, picnic, baby_change, altitude_m, ext.area.pass, ext.area.access_road, ext.area.stay_on_site, ext.area.child_trails.
